'''Cole Darba''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Citizens' Militia]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Darba and his men had been stationed at [[Manister Base]], which had become overrun by a hive of [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] from the nearby [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. While holed up in one of the base's buildings, he was found by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]]. Darba didn't believe that he and his men would withstand another assault, but the spacer told him that they would push back the Geonosians while the militiamen fled to [[Outpost Largona]] to the south.
